rationale: The answer is a well-evidenced, decision-ready review. I spot-checked every load-bearing claim against the cited sources: pnpm monorepo layout (package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml), dual editor-engine dependencies and legacy shims (desktop package.json, muya-core.d.ts, muya.d.ts, electron.vite.config.ts), the sandboxed security boundary (config.ts, preload/index.ts, app/index.ts webview/navigation policy, context-isolation.spec.ts), WindowManager's coupled responsibilities, the BrowserWindow.id vs durable buffer id split (editor.ts:139-145), the cross-layer file workflow and the save/save-as TODO (file.ts:36, editor store FILE_SAVE), the main-side file semantics (filesystem/index.ts, markdown.ts, watcher.ts), editor.vue adapter logic (dual history, adaptSelectionChange, json-change), the permissive IPC contract and void-vs-boolean mismatch (ipc.ts:85 vs editorBufferStore/index.ts:187-198), and IFileState mixing UI/engine/document state (files.ts:62-91). All verified. The answer also correctly flagged three documentation/implementation disagreements (ARCHITECTURE.md describing the old root-src/JS-Muya layout; CLAUDE.md's stale security-note; PARITY_SCOREBOARD.md claiming PG14 is xfail while the spec is fixed) and resolved each in favor of current implementation/tests rather than relying on stale docs. The only unverifiable specifics are exact git commit messages/line counts for 565bfcdc, efcaf0c2, d2f0028e, 6c23b1ba, ac273f46 (git is not runnable in this session and objects live outside the checkout); c907b29c is independently confirmed as the flush-before-save fix, and the structural narrative those hashes support is confirmed by current code and PARITY_SCOREBOARD.md provenance. None of this changes the recommendation. Options include status quo, the recommended incremental facade/adapter, and a main-owned Workspace Kernel; the recommendation follows from the verified evidence, and the five-step migration is incremental, observable, and reversible with concrete verification per step. No material or minor factual errors found; gate passes.
